items.t: Flock CEO Addresses Backlash Over Surveillance Cameras
items.d: More than 120,000 Flock cameras are monitoring roads across 7,000 cities nationwide but there’s growing public outrage over privacy concerns and multiple reports of police misuse. In response to the criticism, the surveillance company is unveiling what it calls a major overhaul to its protocols. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY and speaks to Flock founder and CEO Garrett Langley about the back
